name: statpulse
title: StatPulse
description: Control macOS fans, inspect hardware thermals, manage listening TCP ports, toggle Keep Awake, and mute your microphone via StatPulse.
author: minhtri2710

commands.name: system-status
commands.title: System Status & Thermals
commands.description: View live CPU/GPU temperatures, fan RPM, power draw, memory pressure, and active AI agents

commands.name: manage-ports
commands.title: Manage Listening Ports
commands.description: Search listening TCP ports, open in browser/editor, or kill processes

commands.name: fan-profile
commands.title: Set Fan Thermal Policy
commands.description: Switch StatPulse thermal policy between System Auto, Quiet, and Performance

commands.name: toggle-keep-awake
commands.title: Toggle Keep Awake
commands.description: Prevent macOS display and system sleep via StatPulse

commands.name: toggle-mic-mute
commands.title: Toggle Microphone Mute
commands.description: Instantly mute or unmute the default macOS input microphone

commands.name: cleanup-orphans
commands.title: Clean Orphaned Dev Servers
commands.description: Terminate detached node, vite, next, or python dev servers (ppid == 1)
